subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should unconfigured embedded-agent connection and request-timeout retries permanently move from provider SDK calls inside the released prompt-lock window to one full primary-to-fallback orchestrator retry?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but it changes compatibility-sensitive retry timing, fallback traversal, and terminal behavior; repository history and dependency contracts cannot establish the intended permanent runtime policy.

options.title: Approve orchestrator ownership
options.body: Adopt the bounded full-cycle retry while preserving explicit provider maxRetries overrides and current-main session-fence behavior.

options.title: Split the retry relocation
options.body: Land owned transcript writes and takeover resend handling separately while retry ownership receives a narrower design review.

recommendation.title: Approve orchestrator ownership
recommendation.body: Adopt the bounded full-cycle retry while preserving explicit provider maxRetries overrides and current-main session-fence behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the exact prompt-release fence invariant that constrains safe retry placement.
